description: This file defines TypedDicts, data models, and configuration classes related to EnkryptAI API responses and guardrail configurations, used for detecting violations such as toxicity, PII, bias, and policy violations.

classes.name: EnkryptAIToxicityDetail
classes.description: Details for toxicity detection, including scores for various toxicity types.

classes.name: EnkryptAIResponseSummary
classes.description: Summary of detected violations in EnkryptAI response.

classes.name: EnkryptAIResponse
classes.description: Complete response from EnkryptAI Guardrails API.

classes.name: EnkryptAIProcessedResult
classes.description: Processed result from EnkryptAI guardrail response.

classes.name: EnkryptAIGuardrailConfigs
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the EnkryptAI guardrail.

classes.name: EnkryptAIGuardrailConfigModel
classes.description: Combined configuration model inheriting from GuardrailConfigModel and EnkryptAIGuardrailConfigs.

methods.name: ui_friendly_name
methods.description: Returns the user-friendly name for the guardrail configuration, 'EnkryptAI'.
